title: VIX futures & options March expiration (SOQ settlement) — settles on FOMC decision morning
source: OCC: TWO independent Cboe primary surfaces fetched direct 2026-09-05 by this event's own initial research (docs/research/events/vix-expiration-2027-03-17.md, leg 1). (1) cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement (HTTP 200, 536,634 bytes) parsed row-by-row into 95 symbol/expiry/price rows across its two published settlement dates: the table carries a live contract row rendered `"VX/H7", " - ", "2027-03-17"` with real daily settlement prices against it (20.7295 on 2026-09-04, 20.8641 on 2026-09-03). (2) The machine-readable endpoint www-api.cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement/csv?dt=2026-09-04 (HTTP 200, 1,731 bytes) independently returns the row `VX,VX/H7,2027-03-17,20.7295`. Arithmetic cross-check: 2027-03-17 is a Wednesday exactly 30 calendar days before 2027-04-16, April's third Friday. The 30-day rule now reproduces on ALL NINE listed VX contracts, including the VX/K7 - 2027-05-18 row that opex-2027-03-19's sweep recorded as unexplained: Juneteenth 2027 is observed Friday 2027-06-18 (nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, fetched the same day), closing June's third Friday and moving the June SPX expiration to Thursday 2027-06-17, which is 30 days after Tuesday 2027-05-18 — corroborated by the VA/M7 - 2027-06-17 row on the same Cboe page. Two Cboe surfaces plus an arithmetic check is the standard that promoted the sibling vix-expiration-2026-09-16, and `OCC:` is the prefix market-events-data.ts defines for exactly this class (theocc.com / Cboe; 3rd-Friday standard). PROMOTED from `estimate` at this event's own initial research, which is the sanctioned venue for the flip the discovering sweep correctly declined to make
notes: DISCOVERED during the opex-2027-03-19 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05) and researched on its own the same day; date promoted to `confirmed` by that research. VIX contracts AM-settle to a Special Opening Quotation (VRO) built from the opening auction of a SINGLE SPX/SPXW expiration exactly 30 days out — here the 2027-04-16 series (proposed as opex-2027-04-16 in the same PR), NOT the 2027-03-19 witching — and the expiring contract stops trading 09:00 ET, roughly five hours BEFORE the 14:00 ET FOMC decision that same day (fomc-2027-03-17, estimate, the first SEP of 2027). Two structural consequences: FOMC-day volatility exposure cannot live in the expiring VIX contract, so the vol complex's hedges leave the board on the MORNING of the decision, two sessions before the equity witching; and the front VIX future into the 2027-03-19 witching is therefore the APRIL contract (VX/J7, expiry 2027-04-21). THE ONE STRUCTURALLY NEW FEATURE versus the September 2026 sibling, and the reason this ledger is not just a pointer to it: the SOQ's 30-day strip (2027-03-18 -> 2027-04-16) CONTAINS a market closure, Good Friday 2027-03-26, giving 21 trading sessions where a clean strip has 22 — a theoretical ~0.48-point calendar-vs-trading-time drag at VX/H7's 20.73. The initial research TESTED that against Cboe's own curve and REFUSED the strong form: the full business-time correction makes the curve less smooth than no correction at all, and VX/H7's log(dte)-fit residual is +0.16 (rich), not negative. Impact LOW: it supports one execution guard (nothing trades the 03-17 opening auction), one structural placement note, and one banked refusal. It licenses nothing.
